parent.r58_result: Original G4 full Windows/Ubuntu, G5/G7 PASS, original 5376/5376 categorical parity; 2/2 TASK_ADMISSION_NO_GO because MLP OOD .117/.203 and GRU OOD .125 despite 100% FIT interpolation; per-law anti-generalization, not infrastructure failure.

pre_freeze_pilot.source: separate local prototype using distinct seeds 11,15,22; no R59 formal seeds or worlds
pre_freeze_pilot.pilot_parameters: 4 nonlinear causal response families, three actually selected source probes, proxy nuisance, action-contrast observation noise .24, target range FIT ±.9/OOD ±1.3, MLP and GRU 1200 DEV updates
pre_freeze_pilot.purpose: Verify approximate task difficulty and baseline competence before formal freeze, not selection/tuning based on any R59 heldout outcomes.

hypothesis: Compared to R58's held-out parity-law combination anti-generalization, training across four causal intervention response families with continuously novel world parameters and correctly observed selected action consequences should let conventional MLP/GRU learn portable target-action rules, but still leave nontrivial noisy uncertainty and fixed-expert headroom. Evaluate task admission only, not a novel mechanism.

causal_laws.family_index_rule: case_index mod 4 for each split, hidden evaluator-only, exact balanced family counts
causal_laws.mechanism: For do(action0) at public probe x, true terminal goal effect +f(x); do(action1) effect -f(x). An independent selected sensor noise and action-invariant public nuisance affect measured probe observations but not true causal law.
causal_laws.new_world_transfer: FIT, FIT heldout, CAL and OOD draw independent latent a,b,c,h coefficients and proxy noise from distinct pre-frozen salts; all four functional families occur in all splits. The unfamiliar distribution changes proxy scale and widens public target x; it DOES NOT hold out an entire functional family. This is parameter/context transfer, not new-law-family discovery.
causal_laws.future_goal: At an unobserved public target coordinate t, choose action0 if f(t)>=0 else action1; training labels from independent actually selected target-action0 and target-action1 trials, never included in model features; evaluation labels remain evaluator-only.
causal_laws.not_claimed: A neural classifier predicting on explicitly pre-encoded selected contrasts is not autonomously discovering causal structure, true open-world intelligence, policy selection, or Native substrate gain.

source.selected_terminal_contrast: 0.5*(actually observed action0 physical terminal effect - actually observed action1 effect) at each public source x, with two independent selected action measurement noises and a common action-invariant nuisance.
source.selected_proxy_contrast: Same selected action0/action1 difference at independent noncausal proxy sensor; proxy draw independent of causal coefficients and target class, scale increases on OOD.
source.FIT_training_return_custody: After three probe interventions, select target-action0 and target-action1 on two independent reset goal trials, observe noiseless ±f(target) and use only for FIT labels and optional evaluator provenance; do not append either to model feature vector.
source.unseen_CAL_OOD_return: Evaluate latent target intervention objective after policy decision; no unselected target-action effect or optimal label ever in model input.
source.public_only_analytic_quadratic: Public 3-point Lagrange quadratic interpolation on actually observed selected terminal contrasts at the three known x probe values; decision at public target x. A strong HANDCODED interpolator that may be as good as neural models but is not learned causal mechanism.
negative_controls: public majority of 3 terminal contrast signs
replace all selected terminal contrast features with zeros but retain proxy/context
zero all selected proxy contrast inputs but retain terminal/context
FIT-only label permutation diagnostic (separate smaller control budget; do not train on OOD)
source.source_only_source_sanity: All four causal families present in every split, both return labels present and 40%-60% target class balance each split, no numerical leakage of family id/coefficient/salt/return target into model features. Selected outcome records all from actually selected actions.
forbidden_model_inputs: target action effect at unobserved t

trained_controls.GRU_architecture: 3 public probe steps of 4 input values [x,terminal contrast,proxy contrast,public target t] -> 32 hidden GRU ->2 logits
trained_controls.record: Exact platform SHA/receipt, source-only summary, actual optimizer steps and FIT gradients, train+heldout+CAL+OOD categorical choices and metrics, all negative controls and original TRAIN/TEST source custody, model parameters and run walltime.

admission.failure_policy: Preserve frozen source task admission NO-GO if any prespecified check fails. Do not tune this scored cohort or claim independent learning/Native gain.
admission.success_policy: Admit only a benchmark for a distinct subsequently frozen mechanism comparison; include strongest fixed polynomial interpolation and fully qualified conventional controls, matched inputs/actions/compute and cold interference/retention; not independently qualified science.
